name: Community — MiniMax H3 (Character Swap)
author: akatz-ai + UntMods (LoRAs) + lightx2v (Turbo LoRAs) + michaeldune (cards)
description: Two cards for changing who is in an existing clip with MiniMax H3. Character Swap (akatz-ai's LoRA) replaces one chosen person with your character, face, hair and clothes, and leaves everyone else in the shot alone. Head Swap (UntMods' LoRA) gives someone a new face and hair from a head picture and keeps their clothes, props and pose. Both keep the camera, background, motion and the clip's soundtrack, run 5 to 15 s at 480p; on a 12 GB card 5 s takes about 5 minutes, 8 s about 12 and 15 s about 36-40; close browsers for long durations. Next to Viggle Animate, Character Swap can pick one person out of a group, needs no repaint step and has no non-commercial part. Uses the official MiniMax H3 base, encoder and VAEs; with an H3 pack installed the new download is 2.1 GB for Character Swap and 2.0 GB for Head Swap. MiniMax H3 Community License (Character Swap LoRA) and Apache-2.0 (Head Swap LoRA, Turbo LoRAs).

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Character Swap
presets.tagline: Swap one person in a clip for your character
presets.description:
Swap one person in an existing clip for your own character, and leave everyone else in the shot alone. The camera, background, motion and the other people stay, and the clip keeps its own soundtrack.

Put the clip in Reference Video 1 and a picture of the character in the Character slot (a full-body front view or a character sheet works). In the prompt, write only who to replace, for example "the woman in the red coat on the right" or "the man on the left"; the card adds the rest of the instruction.

Output: the first 5 to 15 s of the clip (Duration) at 480p. On a 12 GB card 5 s takes about 5 minutes, 8 s about 12, 11 s about 17 and 15 s about 36. For long durations close browsers and other programs that use the graphics card, since they can make a long render several times slower.

The new face mixes the character with the original performer (brows, face shape, smile), so it is close rather than exact. For the closest match to a character sheet on a single person, use Viggle Animate instead. This card can pick one person out of a group, needs no repaint step and has no non-commercial part.

To change only the face and hair and keep the outfit, use Head Swap.

Licence: MiniMax H3 Community License (Character Swap LoRA) and Apache-2.0 (Turbo LoRA).

Model format: int8 ConvRot.

requirements.notes: Graph: akatz-ai's MiniMax H3 Character Swap V1.5 LoRA (1.0) with lightx2v's FL2V Turbo 8-step 768p LoRA (1.0) on the official Ref2VA int8 base, MiniMaxH3SigmaShift 12/3, BasicGuider CFG 1, er_sde/normal, 8 steps, 124 frames at 864x480, ref_image_size match; core ComfyUI nodes only (akatz's Relay 2.0 custom nodes are not used). New downloads: the swap LoRA (155 MB, HF akatz-ai/MiniMax-H3-Character-Swap-LoRA @ 96ea3407, MiniMax H3 Community License) and the 768p Turbo LoRA (1.96 GB, HF lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo @ a29e57d1, Apache-2.0; not the same file as Comfy-Org's non-768p Turbo 8-step); base, encoder and VAEs are the official MiniMax H3 files, shared with the other H3 packs. All sha256-pinned. TESTED 2026-10-18 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB, engine-direct, 4 clips x 3 seeds (talk, sea, geisha, a two-person cafe shot): the swap held 12/12; on the cafe shot only the target woman changed (3/3, the man's region 25-26 dB against the source). 269-363 s per clip, about 1.8x slower than the Viggle Animate card. A control with the swap LoRA off swapped only the clothes on 2 of 4 clips: the LoRA is what replaces hair and face. Known: the face blends with the source performer; small accessories (a backpack) were kept on 0-3 of 3 seeds depending on the clip. 1.1.0 (2026-10-19) adds Duration 5-10 s: the seconds snap to H3's frame grid (5 + 17n) and the source clip is trimmed to the snapped length. Duration test, engine-direct, talk clip, seed 31: the swap held to the last frame at 8 s (192 frames, 725 s), 10.8 s (260 frames, 1027 s) and 15 s (362 frames, 2188 s, soundtrack 0.97 correlation with the source at 11 ms). A first 10.8 s run took 6461 s with identical output: something else on the machine held memory, not the length. 1.3.0 (2026-10-20) raises the slider to 15 s (362 frames). Untested at 768p, on two look-alike people, and with faster attention.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Head Swap
presets.tagline: New face and hair on someone in a clip, outfit kept
presets.description:
Put a new head on someone in a clip: a new face and hair, and everything else stays. The clothes, props, pose, background and the clip's own soundtrack are kept, and the mouth follows the original performance.

Put the clip in Reference Video 1 and a picture of the head in the Head slot. Crop the picture above the shoulders (face and hair only): any clothes in the picture come along. A four-view character sheet did not swap at all in testing, and a head that clearly differs from the performer swaps most reliably. No prompt is needed.

Good to know: the hair can keep the original's shape and take the new colour (wet, slicked-back or very long hair). This card cannot pick one person out of a group, so with two people in the shot it may change both. Only the head changes, not the body.

Output: the first 5 to 15 s of the clip (Duration) at 480p. On a 12 GB card 5 s takes about 5 minutes, 8 s about 12 and 15 s about 40. For long durations close browsers and other programs that use the graphics card.

To replace one chosen person's whole look, including clothes, use Character Swap.

Licence: Apache-2.0 (Head Swap LoRA, Turbo LoRA).

Model format: int8 ConvRot.
